title: helictotrichon × altius
intro: Helictotrichon × altius, commonly known as Altissimo, is a hybrid ornamental grass in the Poaceae family, resulting from the cross between Helictotrichon sempervirens and H. sanguineum. This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include reducing inflammation and improving sleep quality, making it a sought-after remedy in traditional medicine. The therapeutic actions of Altissimo are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including phenolic acids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which have antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The exact bioactive constituents of Helictotrichon × altius have not been extensively studied, but its traditional use suggests a rich profile of bioactive compounds that may contribute to its therapeutic effects.
